# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")

stopifnot(dir.exists(hrs_dir))

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Read Data

```{r read}
pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "phenotype.csv"))
mem_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "hcap_memory_scores_by_subject.csv"))
smoke_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "smoking.csv"))
```

# Merge Data

```{r merge}
# Whole years plus months as a fraction of a year; months are optional
years_plus_months <- function(years, months) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(years) ~ NA_real_,
    is.na(months) ~ years,
    TRUE ~ years + months / 12
  )
}

merge_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mem_df,
    by = c("HHID", "PN"),
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    smoke_df,
    by = c("HHID", "PN", "SubjectID_Submitter"),
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_year = .data$R1IWYEAR - .data$RABYEAR,
    Age_month = .data$R1IWMONTH - .data$RABMONTH,
    time_year = .data$R2IWYEAR - .data$R1IWYEAR,
    time_month = .data$R2IWMONTH - .data$R1IWMONTH,
    Smoking_Imputed = ifelse(is.na(.data$Smoking), 1, 0),
    Smoking = ifelse(is.na(.data$Smoking), .data$Smoking_Class, .data$Smoking),
    Age = years_plus_months(.data$Age_year, .data$Age_month),
    time = years_plus_months(.data$time_year, .data$time_month),
    Education_category = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$RAEDUC) ~ NA_character_,
      .data$RAEDUC == 1 ~ "No_Degree",
      .data$RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ "HS",
      .data$RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ "College",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Gender = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$RAGENDER) ~ NA_character_,
      .data$RAGENDER == 1 ~ "Male",
      .data$RAGENDER == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    APOE4_carrier = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$APOE4) ~ NA_character_,
      .data$APOE4 == 0 ~ "No",
      .data$APOE4 %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

# Filter

```{r filter}
merge_df <- merge_df %>%
  # Filter to NHW MCI
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$RAHISPAN),
    .data$RAHISPAN == 0,
    !is.na(.data$RARACEM),
    .data$RARACEM == 1,
    !is.na(.data$VS1HCAPDX_EAP),
    # EAP is 1 = Cognitive Normal, 2 = Mild Cognitive Impairment, 3 = Dementia
    .data$VS1HCAPDX_EAP == 2
  ) %>%
  # Filter to having DNAm data
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$SubjectID_Submitter),
    .data$SubjectID_Submitter %in% smoke_df$SubjectID_Submitter
  ) %>%
  # Filter to having age, sex, pTau, vs4mem_eap, and APOE4
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$Age),
    !is.na(.data$Gender),
    !is.na(.data$PPTAU181),
    !is.na(.data$VS4MEM_EAP),
    !is.na(.data$APOE4)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "HHID",
    "PN",
    "SubjectID_Submitter",
    "Gender",
    "Age",
    "time",
    Education = "RAEDYRS",
    "Education_category",
    "APOE4_carrier",
    "APOE4",
    "Smoking",
    "Smoking_Predicted",
    "Smoking_Class",
    "Smoking_Binary",
    "Smoking_Score",
    "Smoking_Current",
    "Smoking_Former",
    "Smoking_Never",
    "Smoking_Imputed",
    "prop_GR",
    "prop_NK",
    "prop_B",
    "prop_CD4",
    "prop_CD8",
    "prop_MO",
    "PAB42_40_RATIO",
    "PPTAU181",
    "PGFAP",
    "PNFL",
    "LOG_AB42_40_RATIO",
    "LOG_PTAU181",
    "LOG_GFAP",
    "LOG_NFL",
    "VS4MEM_EAP",
    "VS4MEM_PV",
    "SUT_MEM_16",
    "SUT_MEM_22",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3_16",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3_22",
    "SUT_MEM_ALL8_16",
    "SUT_MEM_ALL8_22",
    "OSHEA_MEM_16",
    "OSHEA_MEM_22",
    "OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_16",
    "OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_22",
    "SUT_MEM_COUNT_16",
    "SUT_MEM_COUNT_22",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3_COUNT_16",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3_COUNT_22",
    "OSHEA_MEM_COUNT_16",
    "OSHEA_MEM_COUNT_22",
    "SUTIN_CERAD_BOTH_WAVES",
    "SUTIN_ALL8_BOTH_WAVES",
    "OSHEA_ALL6_BOTH_WAVES",
    "VS2MEMIMP_EAP"
  )
```

# Calculate Scaled Biomarkers

```{r scale_bio}
merge_df <- merge_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Z_AB42_PATHOLOGY = -as.numeric(scale(.data$LOG_AB42_40_RATIO)),
    Z_PTAU181 = as.numeric(scale(.data$LOG_PTAU181)),
    Z_GFAP = as.numeric(scale(.data$LOG_GFAP)),
    Z_NFL = as.numeric(scale(.data$LOG_NFL))
  )
```

# Save

```{r save}
write.csv(
  merge_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "NHW_HCAP_MCI.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Save Longitudinal

```{r save_long}
# Save the subjects whose `both_waves_flag` column is TRUE
write_longitudinal <- function(long_df, both_waves_flag, file_name) {
  write.csv(
    long_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[[both_waves_flag]]),
    file = file.path(data_dir, file_name),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

long_df <- merge_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$time), .data$time > 0)

write_longitudinal(
  long_df, "SUTIN_ALL8_BOTH_WAVES", "NHW_HCAP_Longitudinal_Sutin.csv"
)
write_longitudinal(
  long_df, "SUTIN_CERAD_BOTH_WAVES", "NHW_HCAP_Longitudinal_Cerad.csv"
)
write_longitudinal(
  long_df, "OSHEA_ALL6_BOTH_WAVES", "NHW_HCAP_Longitudinal_Oshea.csv"
)
```
